name: Lore
desc: Bards of the College of Lore know something about most things, collecting bits of knowledge from sources as diverse as scholarly tomes and peasant tales. Whether singing folk ballads in taverns or elaborate compositions in royal courts, these bards use their gifts to hold audiences spellbound. When the applause dies down, the audience members might find themselves questioning everything they held to be true, from their faith in the priesthood of the local temple to their loyalty to the king. The loyalty of these bards lies in the pursuit of beauty and truth, not in fealty to a monarch or following the tenets of a deity. A noble who keeps such a bard as a herald or advisor knows that the bard would rather be honest than politic. The college's members gather in libraries and sometimes in actual colleges, complete with classrooms and dormitories, to share their lore with one another. They also meet at festivals or affairs of state, where they can expose corruption, unravel lies, and poke fun at self-important figures of authority.
content: The Bard subclass named Lore (College of Lore) is a group of bards who gather knowledge from various sources to captivate audiences with their storytelling and music. These bards value truth and beauty over loyalty to monarchs or deities, using their gifts to challenge beliefs and expose corruption. They are known for their honesty and ability to unravel lies, often serving as heralds or advisors to nobles. Members of the College of Lore share their wisdom in libraries and colleges, as well as at festivals and state events, where they use their skills to question authority and entertain crowds with their wit and insight.

name: Berserker
desc: For some barbarians, rage is a means to an end--that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood. As you enter the berserker's rage, you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own health or well-being.
content: The Berserker subclass of the Barbarian class, known for its Primal Path, embodies unbridled fury and a thirst for battle. As Berserkers rage, they revel in the chaos of combat, disregarding their own well-being in pursuit of violence. This subclass emphasizes relentless aggression and a disregard for personal safety, making it a formidable force on the battlefield.

name: Life
desc: The Life domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy--one of the fundamental forces of the universe--that sustains all life. The gods of life promote vitality and health through healing the sick and wounded, caring for those in need, and driving away the forces of death and undeath. Almost any non-evil deity can claim influence over this domain, particularly agricultural deities, sun gods, gods of healing or endurance, and gods of home and community.
content: The Life subclass (Divine Domain) for the Cleric class focuses on harnessing vibrant positive energy to promote vitality, health, and healing. Deities of agriculture, the sun, healing, endurance, home, and community are often associated with this domain. Spells like Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon, Beacon of Hope, Revivify, Death Ward, Mass Cure Wounds, and Raise Dead are accessible at various cleric levels, showcasing the subclass's emphasis on life-affirming magic.

name: Champion
desc: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.
content: Champion (Fighter) is a Martial Archetype that focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection, combining rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

name: Open Hand
desc: Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents, manipulate ki to heal damage to their bodies, and practice advanced meditation that can protect them from harm.
content: The Open Hand subclass (Monastic Tradition) for the Monk class in martial arts combat specializes in pushing and tripping opponents, healing damage with ki, and practicing advanced meditation for protection.

name: Thief
desc: You hone your skills in the larcenous arts. Burglars, bandits, cutpurses, and other criminals typically follow this archetype, but so do rogues who prefer to think of themselves as professional treasure seekers, explorers, delvers, and investigators. In addition to improving your agility and stealth, you learn skills useful for delving into ancient ruins, reading unfamiliar languages, and using magic items you normally couldn't employ.
content: The Thief subclass (Roguish Archetype) is a part of the Rogue class, specializing in the larcenous arts and agility. Thieves are skilled in burglary, banditry, and stealth, making them ideal for treasure seeking and exploration. They excel in delving into ruins, deciphering languages, and utilizing magic items beyond their usual capabilities. Ideal for those who prefer a cunning and deceptive playstyle, Thieves are versatile and resourceful in their approach to challenges.

name: Draconic
desc: Your innate magic comes from draconic magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors. Most often, sorcerers with this origin trace their descent back to a mighty sorcerer of ancient times who made a bargain with a dragon or who might even have claimed a dragon parent. Some of these bloodlines are well established in the world, but most are obscure. Any given sorcerer could be the first of a new bloodline, as a result of a pact or some other exceptional circumstance.
content: The Draconic subclass (Sorcerous Origin) for the Sorcerer class draws on innate magic from draconic bloodlines, potentially stemming from ancient bargains with dragons or dragon ancestry. Sorcerers with this origin may be the first of a new bloodline, with established or obscure lineages. This subclass emphasizes the mystical connection to dragons, offering unique abilities and powers to those who embrace it.

name: Devotion
desc: The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order. Sometimes called cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins meet the ideal of the knight in shining armor, acting with honor in pursuit of justice and the greater good. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some, for better or worse, hold the rest of the world to the same standards. Many who swear this oath are devoted to gods of law and good and use their gods' tenets as the measure of their devotion. They hold angels--the perfect servants of good--as their ideals, and incorporate images of angelic wings into their helmets or coats of arms.
content: The Devotion subclass (Sacred Oath) of the Paladin class embodies justice, virtue, and order. Also known as cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins uphold the highest standards of conduct and pursue justice and the greater good. Aligned with gods of law and good, they revere angels as their ideals and incorporate angelic imagery into their armor. The Oath of Devotion grants access to spells like Protection from Evil and Good, Sanctuary, Lesser Restoration, Zone of Truth, Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic, Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith, Commune, and Flame Strike. This subclass showcases a commitment to righteousness and divine powers that aid in combat and protection.

name: Fiend
desc: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence, a being whose aims are evil, even if you strive against those aims. Such beings desire the corruption or destruction of all things, ultimately including you. Fiends powerful enough to forge a pact include demon lords such as Demogorgon, Orcus, Fraz'Urb-luu, and Baphomet; archdevils such as Asmodeus, Dispater, Mephistopheles, and Belial; pit fiends and balors that are especially mighty; and ultroloths and other lords of the yugoloths.
content: The Fiend (Otherworldly Patron) subclass of the Warlock class is a powerful entity from the lower planes of existence, with evil aims that may corrupt or destroy all things, including the pact-maker. Known fiends include demon lords like Demogorgon and archdevils such as Asmodeus. The subclass grants access to spells like Burning Hands and Fireball, with prerequisites at various Warlock levels. Skills associated with this subclass include dark magic and infernal powers, making it a formidable choice for those willing to embrace darkness in exchange for power.

name: Evocation
desc: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid. Some evokers find employment in military forces, serving as artillery to blast enemy armies from afar. Others use their spectacular power to protect the weak, while some seek their own gain as bandits, adventurers, or aspiring tyrants.
content: Evocation (Arcane Tradition) is a subclass of the Wizard class, focusing on powerful elemental magic such as cold, flame, thunder, lightning, and acid. Evokers can serve as artillery in military forces, protect the weak, or pursue personal gain as bandits, adventurers, or aspiring tyrants.

name: Hunter
desc: Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization and the terrors of the wilderness. As you walk the Hunter's path, you learn specialized techniques for fighting the threats you face, from rampaging ogres and hordes of orcs to towering giants and terrifying dragons.
content: The Hunter subclass of the Ranger class, known as the Ranger Archetype, embodies a protector of civilization against wilderness threats. This subclass specializes in fighting various dangers like ogres, orcs, giants, and dragons. As a Hunter, you learn unique techniques to combat these formidable foes and serve as a stalwart defender.

name: Land
desc: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.
content: The Land subclass (Druid Circle) within the Druid class focuses on safeguarding ancient knowledge and rites through an oral tradition, with magic influenced by the land of initiation. Spells associated with this subclass include Hold Person, Spike Growth, Sleet Storm, Slow, Freedom of Movement, Ice Storm, Commune With Nature, Cone of Cold, Mirror Image, Misty Step, Water Breathing, Water Walk, Control Water, Conjure Elemental, Scrying, Blur, Silence, Create Food and Water, Protection From Energy, Blight, Hallucinatory Terrain, Insect Plague, Wall of Stone, Barkskin, Spider Climb, Call Lightning, Plant Growth, Divination, Tree Stride, Invisibility, Pass Without Trace, Daylight, Haste, Dream, Acid Arrow, Darkness, Stinking Cloud, Locate Creature, Lightning Bolt, Meld Into Stone, Stone Shape, Stoneskin, Passwall, and Wall of Stone.
